resolution.note: selectTests follows imports transitively; tests assert gauge.ts selects context-replay.test.ts

title: npm run fast selects tests that import a changed module transitively
body:
Source: lead session 2026-11-16, PR #1212 (t-v9zxepq): `npm run fast` passed locally (28 related tests) after changing src/context/gauge.ts, but CI went red on test/claude/context-replay.test.ts ("the real gauge hook advises inside the step that crosses the threshold"), which imports src/context/replay.ts, which imports gauge.ts. The related-test selection missed a transitive importer, costing one red Check and a reship.
Outcome: the fast related-test selection includes tests that import a changed module transitively (at least two import hops), so changing src/context/gauge.ts selects test/claude/context-replay.test.ts; a test asserts that selection.
Proof: a test in test/ asserts the related set for src/context/gauge.ts contains test/claude/context-replay.test.ts.
Files: scripts/fast-check.ts, src/
